context: A boss discusses a corporate security review
purpose: Teach: 暗殺/強盗/誘拐/人質/テロリスト/右翼/左翼/慶

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 警備会社報告で、暗殺予告は無いが、強盗対策、強化と。
lines.en: Security report came back—no assassination threats, but we're strengthening robbery countermeasures.
lines.style: Clipped, businesslike. Steady eye contact. Delivers the reassurance first, the directive second. No wasted breath.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。誘拐想定の訓練、社員に対し、人質シミュレーションも実施します。
lines.en: Understood. We'll run kidnapping drills and hostage simulations with the staff.
lines.style: Measured, note-taking pace. Slight nod on acknowledgment. Methodical—each element ticked off mentally. Professional courtesy without warmth.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: テロリスト想定、海外赴任予定者は特に重点的に。
lines.en: Especially those transferring overseas—prioritize terrorist scenario training for them.
lines.style: Directive tone, weight on 'especially.' No inflection softening the instruction. Strategic, not alarming. This is what preparation looks like.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 国内では、右翼や左翼の街宣車対応も、マニュアル化中。
lines.en: Domestically we're also standardizing protocols for far-right and far-left van protests.
lines.style: Status update delivered flatly. Factual, thorough. A slight uptick in pace—momentum of work being done. No apologizing for the comprehensiveness.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 慶應大の危機管理研究室にも、助言を仰ごう。
lines.en: We should get advisory input from Keio's crisis management research center as well.
lines.style: Closing thought, slightly softer. Acknowledgment that expertise exists elsewhere. Measured, confident. The period feels final but not abrupt.
